component.name: Vessel
component.summary: Nexus Mods manager for Steam and Proton games

description.p: Vessel installs, orders and deploys mods from Nexus Mods for Steam and Proton games on Linux and the Steam Deck. It handles FOMOD installers, collections, LOOT plugin sorting and nxm:// download links.
The package ships the desktop app and the vessel command-line tool.
